title: Super Mario Bros. Wonder's online service is up on OpenPak
body: Super Mario Bros. Wonder's online service is now running on OpenPak, with the sign-in, friends and game session pieces in place. The console needs a small client patch before online play will work. Nothing about the game's online features has been confirmed on hardware yet, so testing is ongoing.
footer: OpenPak Super Mario Bros. Wonder — playable, not promised.
